messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

output:
Company name is invented (Verity Scheduling) since you didn't give one — swap it and the specifics (year, headcount, clinic count, certifications) for real numbers before this goes anywhere near a website.

---

## About Verity Scheduling

We started Verity in 2019 because a friend of ours ran the front desk at a three-provider family practice in Tacoma, and spent her mornings on the phone rebooking people the software had double-listed.

That's the whole origin story. No garage, no epiphany.

Clinic scheduling looks simple from the outside. It isn't. One appointment carries a provider, a room, a piece of equipment, an insurance authorization that may or may not have come back, and a patient who works second shift and can only come in before nine. Most calendar tools handle the first two and shrug at the rest. Ours was built around the rest.

Today about 1,400 clinics use us, most of them between two and twenty providers. Primary care, dermatology, physical therapy, a fair number of behavioral health practices. We don't sell to hospital systems. We tried, twice, and learned that what a 900-bed system needs and what a small orthopedic group needs are different products, and we'd rather be good at one of them.

We're 34 people across four time zones, and roughly a third of us worked in a clinic before working here. Those are the people who answer support. Email on a Tuesday afternoon and you'll usually hear back the same day, from someone who knows what a no-show rate does to a month.

We're HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II audited, and we'll show you the report before you ask.

Come see whether we fit.

---

262 words. I ran it through this repo's own `slopwatch` ruleset — it passes the live gate with no blocking issues.
